description: This bar chart, titled "Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling," illustrates the percentage values associated with discrete categories along the horizontal axis, which are labeled from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The vertical axis, labeled "Percentage," is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart contains five light blue bars, each corresponding to a specific x-axis value and annotated with its percentage value: the bar at x=0.0 is 11.2%, the bar at x=0.2 is 3.4%, the bar at x=0.4 is 3.4%, the bar at x=0.6 is 5.8%, and the bar at x=1.0 is 76.2%. A red dashed vertical line is drawn at x=0.8, and a red text annotation indicates "mean: 0.82" positioned near the top of the chart, above the bar at x=1.0. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in ascending order of their x-axis position. There is no legend or additional visual emphasis on any specific bar.
